style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

Play as British Raj. Take the focuses for Mughal rebellion. If done right, it's possible to seize the entirety of the Raj during the civil war. Use focuses to attack and annex Afghanistan, Sinkiang, Iran, and Iraq, in this order. The biggest difficulty is that you only have until late 1940 to get Iraq: any later, and it gets puppeted by the UK. (You can still get the achievement by capitulating British Iraq, but then you'll be stuck in a war against the Allies.) Difficulty: Medium as British Raj, hard to very hard as other three possible countries.

I'm just passing byOwn a state on each continent while being at peace
At peace Owns a state in: Europe Asia Africa Middle East North America South America Australia
Europe Asia Africa Middle East North America South America Australia

Easiest as the East India Company. Here is how to get a state in all continents: Using Just Good Business, you can get Dutch New Guinea (669) (Australia), Curaçao (695) (South America) and any state in the Netherlands (Europe), via a naval invasion from Britain to the Netherlands, using the British navy. Then you can purchase Bermuda (696) (North America), French Somaliland (268) or Madagascar (543) (Africa), and Alexandretta (799) (Middle East). Alternatively, you can purchase Suez (446) and Panamá Canal (685) for the Middle East and South America requirements, if you want to also get the It's Just Good Business achievement.

Can be easily accomplished on historical mode, as long as Sinkiang doesn't become a Soviet puppet. Note that this achievement requires ⟦0⟧ of your cores instead of just occupation; Although this could potentially mean a total war with the allies, the PRC actually has a focus to just request these treaty ports from their occupiers. If you use the tree to switch to Democratic and don't cause much world tension by justifying on anything, it seems that they'll give them up easily to you.

Very easily obtained by taking the historical Mao path with historical focuses on. Just take as many advisors that give you PP as possible. You need to make sure China does well enough to not die to Japan though - Japanese occupation prevents you from infiltrating states/will reset your infiltration progress. Don't bother infiltrating Warlord states, as both the warlord and China have decisions to remove your infiltration, meaning it gets removed much faster than just infiltrating China's states. You don't even have to actually win against Japan, if you progress far enough down the tree you'll be able to leave the United front and make your own faction, letting you declare war and get the achievement earlier.
